interpretation.plain_speak: Temporal history really adds information, but it is not a magic fix. It improves calibration and catches three more flips on this held-out phase, while precision stays around 31%.
interpretation.north_star_question: Supports keeping temporal history in the native risk estimate, while showing that trigger selectivity—not basic detectability—is now the main B-lane limitation.
interpretation.next_stage: map a frozen threshold precision-recall frontier on a fresh phase before selecting any future bounded intervention trigger
